comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator and agent1 the pedestrian responder; the pedestrian crosses the trafficway without following another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: an unmarked, straight, two-way crossing; ego approaches at 2.5–3 m/s, then accelerates after 1 s. Agent1 starts on the near sidewalk 18–20 m ahead, walking left at 1.2–1.4 m/s, pauses when ego comes within 15–16 m, and resumes after ego recedes beyond 20 m. The car acceleration creates the conflict; pedestrian crossing is already underway. Speeds, locations, response thresholds and the 16 s horizon are assumptions; a collision is not required.
